rules.suppression: Read the shared suppression registry immediately before every send; suppressed or unverifiable means do not send. Any STOP/opt-out writes the shared registry first.
rules.dedupe: One send per (lead_id, template_id, trigger_event_id). The trigger is a stored event id from the adapter timeline, never a timer.
rules.retry: At most 2 retries on a provider error with no delivery receipt, 10 then 60 minutes later, under the same dedupe key. Never retry after a delivery or an opt-out.
rules.quiet_hours: Texts only 8am–8pm in the recipient's local time; otherwise defer to the next window.
rules.content: Never mention abuse, a facility, a case or eligibility in a text or email preview line. No outcome or qualification language.
rules.owner_on_failure: intake-operations (Phillips Law Group) via the failed-handoff alert below; Marketing Apes ops is the backup owner.
